description: This file defines two Flutter widgets, Skeleton and CircleSkeleton, used as placeholder loading skeletons with configurable appearance.

classes.name: Skeleton
classes.description: A customizable rectangular Skeleton widget with adjustable height, width, number of layers, and corner radius.

classes.name: CircleSkeleton
classes.description: A circular Skeleton widget with adjustable size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for Skeleton and CircleSkeleton, returning styled Containers acting as placeholders.
